item.title: Blue Seal Ice Cream — Guide
item.description: Blue Seal is Okinawa’s most iconic and beloved ice cream brand, a cheerful, retro-American institution found across the islands. Originally established in the late 1940s to supply the US military bases, its slogan ‘Born in America, raised in Okinawa’ captures its heritage — a fusion of American-style ice cream with distinctly Okinawan and tropical flavours. Alongside familiar favourites, Blue Seal is famous for local and exotic varieties such as beni-imo (Okinawan purple sweet potato), Okinawa salt cookie, sugar cane, mango, ube, and various tropical fruits, all displayed in colourful array.
